svg.title: Repetition and spike messages from Error Signal on Discord
svg.desc: An error in a job posted on its 8th occurrence in 12 minutes, with the job class and id; below it, the SPIKE message with an @here mention when the same error passes 50 occurrences in 5 minutes.
